scope: Source/settings metadata only; no historical returns or risk series computed
daily_bank_semantics: At first observed source chart bar on new Date, bank previous observed Date TR if its weekday is Monday-Friday. TR=max(DayHi,PrevDayClose)-min(DayLo,PrevDayClose), or hi-lo if no previous close. PrevDayClose updates for every observed Date, including Sunday. New Date DayHi/Lo starts with current entire chart candle. Ring mean15; source chart midnight candle includes previous bar_minutes-1 native minutes. Date/weekday are source chart timezone, not necessarily CT. Last close is last observed source chart candle, not an imputed23:59 minute.
risk_boundary_warning: ONB30/ML15min; EOS/LDF/MON/NFP/MOC5min. CLS5min Eastern Date reset is23:00CT, so CT civil daily_atr is not source-exact. Gaps/feed mismatch cannot silently authorize risk sizing.
